name: Pale Reach: Windswept Sheep/Dairy Cow cannot be melee-attacked, Shears still credits wool
contract: Issue #8773. Sheep 164156, Black Sheep 164157 and Dairy Cow 164158 used the stock 'Prey' faction with no
non-attackable flag: an ordinary melee attack (or the aggro it provoked) killed them before Almo's Bucket
(365040) or the Shears (365041) could land for Windswept Milk (175074) / To Shear and Return with Wool
(175076). Expected: the animals cannot be melee-attacked, while the item spell still lands and credits
Windswept Wool via the existing on-spellhit script.

steps.label: Place a Windswept Sheep next to the player
Place a Dairy Cow next to the player
the dairy cow cannot be melee-attacked
Accept To Shear and Return with Wool without pre-granting wool
the quest starts with no wool collected yet
Shear the sheep with the quest Shears
the sheep still cannot be melee-attacked after shearing
